objective: Get 300 Amsterdam cyclists on the Nachtfiets waitlist in two weeks by making stolen lights feel like a solved problem.

tasks.title: Map the Amsterdam bike-light market and who keeps losing lights
Position Nachtfiets and plan two weeks across Instagram, LinkedIn and X
Write the launch posts, one per channel
Ship approved posts and build the campaign page

message_to_team: Team, new client: Nachtfiets, a EUR 9/month bike-light subscription. Goal is 300 waitlist signups in two weeks. Nora, start with the market; Bram, plan on her findings; Lena, three sharp posts; Tariq, ship what the board approves.
